details.description: Enhanced Phonecall is a Deepgram speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Enhanced tier, tuned specifically for low-bandwidth telephone call audio. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists the Enhanced tier, together with Nova 1 and Base, under "Legacy Models," and supports enhanced-phonecall for English only.
advantages: Deepgram documents it as "optimized for low-bandwidth audio phone calls."
Deepgram describes Enhanced-tier models as generally having "higher accuracy and better word recognition than our base models," and handling uncommon words "significantly better."
disadvantages: Deepgram lists the Enhanced tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview.
Supports English only (en, en-US), per Deepgram's language documentation.
use_cases: Transcribing low-bandwidth telephone call recordings (e.g. call centers, phone-based customer service).

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to enhanced-phonecall were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. Unlike enhanced-meeting, Deepgram's Model Options page does not mark enhanced-phonecall as beta. Its Models & Languages Overview groups Enhanced (with Nova 1 and Base) under a 'Legacy Models' heading. The catalog carries no deprecation_date.
